entries.title: Trade #1 decision: BUY LEGO 70779 Protector of Stone @ C$5 (pending pickup)

memo.what: Buy used LEGO Bionicle Protector of Stone 70779, claimed complete (73 pcs), from East Vancouver Craigslist multi-set ad at C$5. Single-set purchase; itemized ask.
memo.why: Ask ~US$3.53 vs LO3 sold US$20.00. Est. eBay net after ~13% fees + US$5 ship ≈ US$12.40 → margin ≈ US$8.87. Fits wallet (~US$10 / C$14.15). Wall-clear: local pickup, eBay buyer-protection sell path, authenticity via set# + completeness check. Thin market (<3 solds in strict 60d) needs 2× margin; margin/ask ≈ 2.5× still clears.
memo.solds: PriceCharting eBay: 2026-08-12 pieces US$29.99; 2026-07-29 complete US$20.00 (LO3); 2026-07-26 complete US$29.34 (63d, used as 3rd). Comp page: https://www.pricecharting.com/game/lego-bionicle/protector-of-stone-70779. FX: BoC FXUSDCAD 1.4145 on 2026-09-25 → fx_usd_per_cad 0.70696.
memo.risk: Completeness unverified until piece count in hand (mask + Skull Spider). Thin market. CL header shows $2 min item — confirm 70779 is C$5 at meetup. Shipping/fee estimates. Seller may prefer multi-set though ad is itemized.
memo.exit: List on eBay.ca as used complete under kernel_experiment with buyer protection; target ≥ LO3 US$20; accept down to est_value floor after fees+ship (~US$12.40 net). If incomplete at pickup, walk away (do not buy).

entries.note: Purchase card issued to operator 2026-09-27. Buy entry E001 will append after paid pickup with receipts. Do not contact seller from Kernel.

entries.title: Trade #1 operator logistics (E001 pickup)
entries.note: Pickup round trip for E001 (LEGO 70779): 19 min one way, 8.1 km each way (16.2 km total). Time ~0.63 hr driving excluding meetup. Logged after E001; hours/km were not on the buy line.

Flag E001 est_value_usd 12.40 as overstated by ~US$9.21 (Controller primary). Buy/FX/receipt identity OK (LEGO 70779 bagged+manual, C$5, BoC 1.4145 on fx_date 2026-09-25 → 0.70696). Comps: of three cited solds, only 2026-07-29 complete US$20 is ≤60d and arguably same condition; 2026-08-12 is Pieces Only (no instructions — not same condition); 2026-07-26 is 63d — thin market. US$5 ship fails Canada Post consumer check from Vancouver: Tracked Packet USA ≤0.25 kg base C$16.28 + 23.5% packet fuel (week Sep 21–27, 2026) = C$20.11 ≈ US$14.21; domestic Regular Parcel ≤0.5 kg also ≳US$11 after 44.5% fuel. Recalc keeping LO3 $20 and 13% fees: 20×0.87−14.21 ≈ US$3.19. Floor overstatement vs cheapest USA Small Packet+fuel: ~US$2.95.
Corrects E001 held value: Canada Post consumer rates (~US$14 tracked) replace assumed US$5 ship; LO3 US$20 − ~13% fees − ~US$14 ship = US$3.19 (was US$12.40; C003).

entries.title: E001 inspection: piece count 67 (complete per manual)
entries.note: Operator inspection of Trade #1 LEGO 70779 Protector of Stone after pickup: Jay counted every piece. Complete at 67 pieces, matching the instruction manual bill of materials. Not 73 (LEGO Shop / Brickset count includes six extra stud ammunition not listed in the manual BOM; packaging historically listed 67). Corrects E001 memo and earlier listing copy that said 73 / claimed complete without a counted inspection. Live eBay listing piece count already corrected by Jay. No cash or held-value change.

Verified E001 after E001a: held value now US$3.19. Math: LO3 US$20 × (1−0.13) − ~US$14 Canada Post tracked ship ≈ US$3.19 (precise C003 path 20×0.87−14.21 = 3.19). Buy/FX/receipts unchanged and OK. cc130e1 was pushed by kernel-agent (correction OK for Kernel). Piece-count operator fact: 70779 is 67 per manual, not 73 — E001a does not repeat 73; N001/E001 still carry 73 and N004 already records the correction for future notes.
Flag N001: memo repeats piece count 73 pcs. Operator/manual fact (N004): 70779 complete BOM is 67, not 73.

interventions.detail: Operator misrouted a Controller instruction to Kernel. Kernel appended check C001 (fdff359) as kernel-agent; the guard correctly flagged it. C001 stands but is Kernel-authored, not an independent check. The Controller verified F001 separately in chat with the same result and will append its own check from its own identity. Root cause: both bots shared one GitHub identity; fixed below.

amendments.summary: Constitution v1.0 adopted. Kernel restated all walls in its own words before naming itself.
Operator holds the challenge wallet and executes every payment; receipts are redacted; operator surname never appears; known limitation on shared credentials.
Kernel may message counterparties directly within limits; the operator sets meeting times and places; messages sent by the operator are written in his own voice.
